title: Pure Sunavalon
summary: Pure Sunavalon combo deck uniting Sunseed, Sunvine, and Sunavalon EARTH Plants into an expansive Extra Deck tree climb, supported by Aromaseraphy Jasmine and staples. Taking damage triggers the Sunavalon great trees to recover Life Points and sprout Sunvine Link extensions, laddering all the way to massive board wipes and monster negates.

summary.title: Starters
points: Sunseed Genius Loci is a Level 1 Plant Normal Monster that single-handedly initiates the entire combo line by Link Summoning Sunavalon Dryas in the Extra Monster Zone.
Sunavalon Dryas searches Sunvine Sowing or Sunvine Shrine on Link Summon, and when you take damage, recovers that damage and Special Summons a Sunvine Link Monster from your Extra Deck.
Sunvine Sowing Special Summons a Sunseed monster from your Deck and inflicts 1000 damage to you, intentionally triggering Sunavalon Dryas's recovery and summon effect.
Sunseed Twin Normal Summons to revive Sunseed Genius Loci from your GY, and banishes itself alongside a Plant Link to revive another Plant Link from your GY.
Sunseed Shadow Special Summons itself from hand next to a Plant Normal Monster and can tribute a Plant Link to summon a Sunavalon Link with the same Link Rating.

summary.title: Opening: Sunseed Genius Loci
steps: Normal Summon Sunseed Genius Loci and use it to Link Summon Sunavalon Dryas in the Extra Monster Zone.
Trigger Sunavalon Dryas to add Sunvine Sowing from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Sunvine Sowing to Special Summon Sunseed Twin from your Deck and take 1000 damage.
Trigger Dryas to regain 1000 LP and Special Summon Sunvine Healer, whose LP gain triggers Aromaseraphy Jasmine to search a Plant.
Use Sunseed Twin to revive Sunseed Genius Loci from the GY, then Link Summon Sunavalon Melias, which revives Genius Loci again to climb into Sunavalon Dryatrentiay.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Sunavalon Dryatrentiay is a Link-4 tree that searches a Sunavalon Spell or Trap on Link Summon, and tributes a linked Plant Link Monster to destroy cards your opponent controls up to that monster's Link Rating.
Sunavalon Bloom negates the effects of all face-up monsters your opponent controls while you control a Link-4 Plant Monster, and boosts a Plant Link Monster's ATK during damage calculation.
Sunavalon Melias revives Sunseed Genius Loci on Link Summon and grants a linked Sunvine Link Monster up to 3 attacks on monsters per Battle Phase.
Teardrop the Rikka Queen detaches 1 material as a Quick Effect to tribute 1 monster on either field.
Benghalancer the Resurgent returns an opponent's Special Summoned monster to the hand as a Quick Effect and revives itself from the GY by banishing 2 Plant monsters.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Sunvine Shrine sends 1 card from hand to GY to Special Summon a Level 4 or lower Plant Normal Monster from your GY once per turn, locking you into Plant Special Summons from the Extra Deck.
Sunvine Cross Breed tributes a Link Monster to Special Summon a Plant monster from your GY in Defense Position.
Sunvine Maiden acts as a handtrap that Special Summons itself from hand and negates an opponent's effect targeting an Extra Deck Plant you control.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Aromage Laurel and larger Rikka and Therion engines are left out of this pure build to preserve maximum focus on the Sunavalon tree climbing sequence.
